request.system:
You are an extraction engine for transcripts of the Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central launch event videos.
You read machine-generated captions that carry a timestamp (seconds) per segment and you return structured JSON.

Hard rules:
- Use only what the transcript says. Do not add product knowledge, context or guesses from outside the transcript.
- Every timestamp you return must be a segment start time "t" that exists in the input, or lie inside a segment's range. Never invent timestamps.
- Quotes must be verbatim substrings of a segment text (same words, same order; you may trim the start and end). 8 to 25 words each. No paraphrasing, no fixing grammar, no stitching segments.
- Status is only what is said or shown in this video: "preview" if they say preview, public preview, beta or similar; "ga" if they say generally available, GA, out of preview, released; "announced" if it is mentioned as coming later, not in this release, roadmap; "unclear" if nothing is said. Always give the quote that proves the status, or null.
- Names of presenters are "as heard"; mark confidence low when the captions could have mangled them.
- No em-dashes anywhere in your text. Use a plain hyphen.
- Write summaries in plain language, no hype words copied from the video (no "exciting", "powerful", "seamless").

output.summary: This video covers the sustainability changes in 2026 release wave two. Formulas now work in purchase orders and purchase invoices, and value chain emissions reach more journals and service management. Scope 3 emissions can be tracked per item tracking level, and the ESG report can print per lot. Sustainability ledger entries get a reverse button, and Collect Amount from GL now suggests only the remaining amount. An end-to-end demo with coffee machines walks through purchase, sale, item journals, reclassification, a service order, reversal, fixed assets and the collect-from-GL change.

chapters.title: UDR note and formula setup recap
Demo: purchase order with formulas, item tracking and fixed asset
Demo: sales order and ESG report per item tracking
Demo: item journal, reclassification and service order
Demo: reversal and fixed asset journals
Demo: collect amount from GL and wrap-up

features.name: Formulas in purchase order and purchase invoice
features.description: Sustainability formulas, previously used in journals, can now be used in the same way on purchase orders and purchase invoices. In the demo the formula is based on distance, which can be edited, while fuel and customer amount cannot, and changes trigger a recalculation.
caveats: In the demo, distance can be modified but fuel and customer amount cannot.
prerequisites: Formula set up on the sustainability account level (shown for account 13171, based on distance).

features.name: Improved finding of sustainability entries
features.description: Sustainability entries can now be found through the system in a way similar to all other entries, making it easier to reach the usual details.

features.name: Value chain emissions across more documents and journals
features.description: Value chain emissions are now available in item journals, the item reclassification journal, the fixed asset reclassification journal and service management. The demo carries emissions through an item journal, a reclassification and a service order.

features.name: Scope 3 tracking by item tracking level
features.description: Scope 3 emissions can be tracked based on the item tracking level. On the item card you define whether to use the average method or the specific method, so lots or serial numbers carry their own emissions.
caveats: The item card holds a default emission value (14 in the demo), which shows in the service order until posting links the correct item tracking.
prerequisites: Choose average or specific method on the item card.
Item tracking (lots or serial numbers) on the items.

features.name: ESG report layout per lot
features.description: The ESG report layout was improved so it can print information per lot. The demo shows emission basis details by item tracking with a total.

features.name: Reverse button for sustainability ledger entries
features.description: Sustainability ledger entries now have a regular reverse button like general ledger entries, replacing the manual entry with opposite signs. Several entries can be selected at once, and the reversed and reversed-by columns link the entries.
caveats: Entries posted through documents cannot be reversed, the same limitation as in general ledger entries.
Only entries created through journals can be reversed.

features.name: Collect Amount from GL remembers posted amounts
features.description: The collect amount from GL function now remembers what was already posted and suggests only the remaining part. The demo shows a second run suggesting the remainder, and a third run suggesting nothing once everything was posted.
caveats: Before this change, the from date and to date filter was extremely important to avoid reposting.

features.name: Emissions on fixed assets in journals
features.description: Fixed assets are now included in emissions. The fixed assets general journal shows sustainability account and total CO2, and the fixed asset reclassification journal has a reclassify CO2 percentage that splits emissions like acquisition cost.

features.name: UDR certificate capture
features.description: UDR certificate capture is named as the last change in the list but is not covered here. The presenter says it will be explained in a separate video.
caveats: Covered in a separate video, not in this one.
